title: Local exploitation around best 16-layer candidate with bounded perturbations
scientific_hypothesis: Fine-scale phase alignment around the iteration_02 best geometry (gradient_thickness__01, score 0.3133) will improve target score by resolving local interference conditions without overshooting into distant minima caused by macroscopic thickness jumps.
design_principle: Targeted local exploitation: initialize 15 candidates by applying bounded Gaussian perturbations (sigma=plus-or-minus 45 nm, clamped 200-1300 nm) to the best candidate's layer array from iteration_02, then run constrained local optimizer (SLSQP) for 30 iterations.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (16 finite layers, alternating starting with ZnS)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
Maintain total layer count less than or equal to 16
manufacturing_considerations: Local refinement reduces risk of large thickness deviations
theory_basis: TMM interference optimization for dichroic filters
Local gradient-based refinement for phase alignment
expected_advantages: Preserves successful interference structure from iteration_02
Reduced optimizer step size prevents overshooting
known_risks: May converge to local optimum if best candidate is not near global optimum
Perturbation bounds may be too restrictive if optimal thicknesses lie outside 200-1300 nm range
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer alternating ZnS/ZnSe stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Initialize 15 candidates by applying Gaussian perturbations (mean=iteration_02 candidate gradient_thickness__01 thicknesses, sigma=45 nm, clamped to 200-1300 nm per layer) to the best candidate from prior iteration. Run SLSQP optimizer for 30 iterations with thickness bounds 200-1300 nm. Evaluate mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm (maximize) and 3000-5000 nm (minimize) at normal incidence, unpolarized. Total layer count fixed at 16. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Shift from global random initialization to targeted local exploitation around iteration_02 best geometry per feedback directive. Applies bounded Gaussian perturbations to candidate gradient_thickness__01 thickness array with SLSQP local optimizer for fine-scale phase alignment.
